company.name: IKAD Engineering
company.headquarters: Khartoum Al-Manshiya, Block 25, Building No. 3, Third Floor, Khartoum, Sudan
company.introduction: IKAD Engineering was established in February 2018 in Khartoum, Sudan, by a group of highly skilled engineers. Recognized across the building construction and infrastructure sectors, IKAD is a privately held company headquartered in Khartoum Al-Manshiya. Through diverse experience in the construction market, the company has built its knowledge, skills, and human resources to meet international standards of time, quality, and safety management.
company.vision: To be a respectable building contractor delivering beyond expectation, always — providing the premier level of service to our community, supported by solid expertise through innovation, proficiency, and association.
company.mission: IKAD is devoted to procuring projects at competitive pricing, providing safe working conditions, and delivering quality work within reasonable time frames — giving the country the highest level of building construction, fire protection, life safety, and security.
company.management: IKAD is driven by two working directors who together bring more than 10 years of experience in the building industry, covering business development, procurement, project management, and administration. The management team proactively gathers feedback, monitors changes in the business environment, reviews work processes, and communicates policy and key learnings to all staff at regular meetings.
company.people: Our people are central to delivering the right solutions for our clients. A comprehensive, ongoing training program keeps every team member equipped with the technical skill, knowledge, and attitude the business demands.

strengths.title: Specialist Fire Protection Expertise
strengths.text: Over 10 years of combined experience designing, installing, inspecting and maintaining fire protection systems for commercial, residential, industrial and institutional facilities.

strengths.title: Experienced Leadership
strengths.text: Directors with 10+ years in the building industry overseeing business development, procurement, project management and administration.

strengths.title: Trusted by Major Institutions
strengths.text: Delivered completed works for leading banks and corporates across Sudan, including multiple branch roll-outs for Bank of Khartoum and Faisal Islamic Bank.

strengths.title: Established Supplier Network
strengths.text: Working relationships with recognized international brands including NAFFCO (UAE) and GESPASA Fluid Technology (Spain).

strengths.title: Trained, Accountable Workforce
strengths.text: A structured training program continually upgrades our people's technical and management capability.

services.name: Fire Protection & Life Safety Systems
services.summary: Design, installation, inspection and maintenance of complete fire protection systems for commercial, residential, industrial and institutional facilities.

items.name: Fire Hydrant Systems
items.text: A large variety of hydrant valves supplied and installed to meet client specifications, with inspection across multiple parameters and timely, cost-effective delivery.

items.name: Automatic Fire Sprinkler Systems
items.text: Design, installation, inspection, servicing and maintenance of automatic sprinkler systems that react quickly to reduce heat, flame and smoke in a fire event.

items.name: Water Mist Fire Suppression Systems
items.text: Fine water-spray systems that control, suppress or extinguish fire by cooling flame and surrounding gases, displacing oxygen, and attenuating radiant heat.

items.name: Foam Extinguishing Systems
items.text: Fixed foam proportioning and discharge equipment protecting high-value, high-hazard sites: fuel and chemical storage tanks and bunds, refineries and petrochemical installations, chemical process plants, loading racks, and airport or helicopter landing areas.

items.name: Foam Equipment — Bladder Tanks
items.text: Bladder tank proportioning systems that inject foam concentrate into the water supply automatically, across a wide range of flows and pressures, without external power.

items.name: FM-200 Clean Agent Suppression
items.text: Clean agent suppression for people, sensitive facilities and irreplaceable assets — applied in computer suites, telecom facilities, railway signaling centers, archives and laboratories, air traffic management centers, petrochemical plants, offshore oil and gas installations, pipeline pumping stations, ship machinery spaces, and rail rolling stock.

items.name: Fire Fighting Pump Sets
items.text: Reliable firefighting pump packages ensuring adequate water supply at required pressure in emergency conditions: FM-approved / UL-listed sets, standard sets, multi-stage outlet (MSMO) sets, and containerized sets.

services.name: HVAC & Air Conditioning
services.summary: Supply and installation of air conditioning and mechanical ventilation systems, working with internationally recognized equipment brands.

services.name: Plumbing & Water Supply Systems
services.summary: Pipework, water supply infrastructure and pump installation for commercial and industrial facilities, including underground pipe laying and water storage tank installation.

services.name: Building Construction & Civil Works
services.summary: Building construction and civil works delivered alongside our MEP scope, from structural shell through to complete interior fit-out.

services.name: Supply of Engineering Equipment
services.summary: Sourcing and supply of fire protection, HVAC and plumbing equipment through established relationships with recognized international manufacturers.
